inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, Next.js pages/components, MDX garden entries, search build script, and MDX loading utilities

anchors.why: Frames the project as a curated directory and resource set for digital gardens, tools, theory, and examples.
Stores individual garden entries as structured MDX content rather than as an opaque list.
Defines the garden content path and loads MDX files into the site data flow.
Builds a searchable projection from source content for browsing.
Renders garden cards, detail pages, and directory navigation as a public-facing projection.

known_limits: This is a curated public directory, not a reviewed knowledge base.
Digital-garden philosophy is useful framing but cannot replace VAKS candidate/review/truth boundaries.
Directory inclusion is not evidence support or endorsement.
